LESSON: COLLAGE

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: FINE ARTS
Strand: Picture Making Techniques (2D Art)
Topic 1.3: Collage
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Collage, part of Picture Making Techniques (2D Art) in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 FINE ARTS.

Key inquiry question: How can the choice of materials affect the durability of a collage?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Collage together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Citizenship: as the learner studies collage artworks done by local and international artists for mentorship.

● Self-efficacy: as the learner presents confidently own and others' college work for feedback.

● Digital literacy: as the learner explores virtual/actual sources to analyse collage artworks done by local and

international artists.

Values:
● Respect: as the learner accommodates diverse opinions during the critique session.

● Responsibility: as the learner observes safety precautions, collect and prepare recyclable materials.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Papers, glue, blade, card boards, unscented glue, heavy gauge paper, multipurpose communication board, text-to- speech software, foot board, Data storage devices

Other Related Service Providers: Resource person, Speech therapist, Learner support assistance, Occupational

Therapist, Physiotherapist,
